reason: I'm already bouncing between a reader site and Discord all day, so one place where I read ORV and talk about it without switching apps is genuinely useful — and it's free, so there's nothing to lose but the setup.
objection: A link-only invite means the link gets screenshotted and passed around, and if half the group never leaves Discord the chat room dies and I'm back to juggling two apps anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If on day one the whole group is already in there — series chats active, not just the founder and two guys — I'm in for good.
